entries.source:
#GOLD#Vim#LAST#
Vim represents the amount of life energy you control. Each corruption talent requires some.
It does not regenerate naturally; you need to drain it from yourself or your victims.
Each time you kill a creature you gain 50% of your Willpower + 1 as Vim.  This value is multiplied by the rank of the creature.
If you can't pay for the Vim cost of a talent you may instead pay with life at a rate of 200% of the Vim cost.
entries.target:
#GOLD#活力#LAST#
活力是你控制的生命能量。施放堕落系法术需要消耗活力值。
活力值不会自动回复，你需要从你自身和你的目标身上吸取。
每杀死一个生物可以吸收意志属性50%+1的活力值。从高分级的生物获得的活力值会乘以分级倍率。
如果你无法支付使用一个技能的活力值，你可以改为支付活力值消耗200%的生命值。

entries.source: The land withers and crumbles wherever this cursed axe rests.
entries.target: 无论这把斧头在哪里，大地都会枯萎和凋零。

entries.source: Loremaster Greynot's Analysis of the Races - Chapter 4 - Shaloren
entries.target: 博学者格雷诺特关于人种的调查——第四章——永恒精灵

entries.source: GODMODE: Target is invulnerable to damage, immune to bad status effects, deals +10000%% damage (100%% penetration), does not need to breathe, and has full ESP.
entries.target: 天神模式：目标不会受到伤害，不会受到负面状态的影响，造成 +10000%% 伤害（100%% 抗性穿透），不需要呼吸，感应所有生物。

entries.source: #Target# is taking damage received in the past!
Select the party member to receive the +2 generic talent points:
entries.target: 选择一名队伍成员获得 +2 通用技能点：

entries.source:
Puts targets in a radius of %d to sleep for %d turns, rendering them unable to act.  Every %d points of damage the target suffers will reduce the effect duration by one turn.
		When Sleep ends, the target will suffer from Insomnia for a number of turns equal to the amount of time it was asleep (up to ten turns max), granting it %d%% sleep immunity for each turn of the Insomnia effect.
		At talent level 5 Sleep will become contagious and has a 25%% chance to spread to nearby targets each turn.
		The damage threshold will scale with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
使 %d 码半径范围内的目标陷入 %d 回合的睡眠状态中，使它们无法行动。它们每承受 %d 点伤害，睡眠的持续时间减少一回合。
		当睡眠结束时，目标会饱受失眠的痛苦，持续回合等于已睡眠的回合数（但最多 10 回合），失眠状态的每一个剩余回合数会让目标获得 %d%% 睡眠免疫。
		在等级 5 时，睡眠会具有传染性，每回合有 25%% 几率传播向附近的目标。
		受精神强度影响，伤害临界点按比例加成。

entries.source: The heart seems to absorb light when you deal darkness damage. Standing on unlit tiles, you feel stronger.
entries.target: 这颗心脏在你造成黑暗伤害的时候会吸收光亮。站在未照亮的方格上，你会变得更强。

entries.source: Full talent respec is always available.
entries.target: 此模式下你可以无限洗点。

entries.source:
Kor'Pul, Kor'Pul... When the farmer told me what this place was called it reminded me of something, and I think it's coming back to me now. My mother used to tell me a story about our ancestors, how they fled by ship to escape the grasp of an evil sorcerer who dominated the lands. The sorcerer was a vile necromancer who took advantage of the destruction from the Spellblaze and the Cataclysm to create huge armies of undead. The people fought against him time and time again, but though he would be defeated he would still come back, sometimes after hundreds of years. And that sorcerer's name was.... Kor'Pul.

Probably just a coincidence.
entries.target:
卡·普尔，卡·普尔……农夫告诉我这里的名字时，我觉得有些耳熟，现在好像渐渐想起来了。妈妈曾对我讲述过我们祖先的故事，关于他们如何乘船逃离一名称霸大陆的邪恶巫师之手。这名卑鄙的死灵法师利用法术大爆炸和大灾变造成的毁灭，建立了庞大的不死军团。人们无数次地与他斗争，但即使他被打败了，仍会卷土重来，有时甚至隔了数百年。那个巫师的名字就是……卡·普尔。

——大概是个巧合吧。

entries.source: A frail skeleton; just about the only bones that aren't cracked are its arms.  It's missing a hand, but a notch has been carved into its wrist to let it pull back a bowstring regardless.
entries.target: 这具破烂不堪的骨架只有一根骨头是好的：它手持长弓的手臂。尽管它缺少了一只手，不过残缺的骨骼上雕刻的凹槽刚好可以卡住弓弦拉弓上箭。

entries.source: %s restores Disruption Shield (+%d) and gains %d mana with Aegis!
entries.target: %s使用守护印记复原了干扰护盾(+%d)并获得%d法力值！

entries.source: They are a sturdy race and are known for their masterwork, yet they are not well loved, having left other races to fend for themselves in past conflicts.
entries.target: 他们是支强壮的种族并以大师级手艺而闻名，但是，由于在过去的战乱中为了自身利益抛弃了其他种族，他们仍然不受欢迎。

entries.source:
Each turn you unleash dark powers through your runeskin.
		For each rune you have a random foe in sight will be hit by a spike of decrepitude, dealing %0.2f frostdusk damage.
		A foe can only be hit by one spike per turn.
		If your life is below 1, the spikes also reduce all damage done by the targets by %d%%.
entries.target:
你每回合都从符文皮肤中释放出黑暗能量。
		你每拥有一个符文，就会用破碎尖刺攻击视野内的一名随机敌人，造成 %0.2f 霜暮伤害。
		每个敌人每回合只会被尖刺攻击一次。
		如果你的生命值在 1 以下，尖刺还会使目标造成的伤害减少 %d%%。

entries.source: This powerful sling is said to have belonged to a warrior so strong his shots could knock down a brick wall...
entries.target: 据说这个强大的投石索曾属于一位强壮的战士，他射出的弹丸能击倒砖墙……

entries.source: * #LIGHT_GREEN#%d%%#LAST# chance to slow global speed by #YELLOW#%d%%#LAST#%s
#LIGHT_BLUE##Target# is no longer a badass tree.

You step out on unfamiliar grounds. You are nearly on top of one of the highest peaks you can see.
The storm is raging above your head.
entries.target:
你进入了一个不熟悉的地方。你几乎站在了你能看到的最高峰位置。
风暴在你的头顶肆虐。

entries.source: You told them nothing and vanquished them.
entries.target: 你什么也没告诉他们，并把他们全都消灭了。

entries.source: This creature is about as tall as a halfling. It is covered in white silky fur and has a disproportionate head. The weirdest thing about it though, its weapon simply floats in front of it.
entries.target: 这只生物像半身人一样高。他浑身被有白色的毛发并有一颗不相称的大头。最不可思议的是，他的武器就那样悬浮在他面前。

entries.source: conjure elemental energy in a radius %d cone, dealing %0.2f to %0.2f %s damage
entries.target: 在半径 %d 的锥形范围内召唤元素能量，造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f %s 伤害。

entries.source:
You pull your awareness fully into the moment, increasing your stealth detection, see invisibility, defense, and accuracy by %d for %d turns.
		If you have Spin Fate active when you cast this spell, you'll gain a bonus to these values equal to 50%% of your spin.
		This spell takes no time to cast.
entries.target:
你将意识完全收束于当下，使潜行侦测、隐形侦测、闪避和命中提高 %d，持续 %d 回合。
		若施放时命运之丝处于激活状态，上述数值还会获得相当于你当前命运之丝总量 50%% 的额外加成。
		施放此法术不消耗回合。

entries.source: #Target# is no longer covered by shadows.
It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning, thrice the size of a normal warg.
entries.target: 一只超级大狼，眼睛里充满了狡猾，比普通座狼大两倍。

entries.source: Automatically fires lightning bolts every game turn at nearby enemies dealing %d to %d lightning damage based on Magic with a chance to inflict Daze.
entries.target: 每回合自动向附近敌人发射闪电，造成%d到%d基于魔法的闪电伤害，并有几率使其眩晕。

entries.source: Became the new master of the arena in 30-wave mode.
entries.target: 在30波模式中成为新的竞技场主宰。

entries.source:
Focus kinetic energy and strike an enemy for %d%% weapon damage as physical.
		They will be pinned to the ground for %d turns by the force of this attack.
		Any frozen creature hit by this attack will take an extra %0.2f physical damage.
		The extra damage will scale with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
聚焦动能打击敌人造成 %d%% 武器伤害
		敌人将被这次攻击的力量定身 %d 回合。
		任何处于冻结状态的目标受到额外 %0.2f 物理伤害。
		额外伤害受精神强度加成。
已出售：%s %s 价格 %0.2f 金币。

entries.source: Your arrows now tune your Paradox %0.2f points towards your preferred Paradox on hit.
entries.target: 当你发射的箭矢命中时，将会使你的紊乱值向预设值调谐 %0.2f 点。

entries.source: It must be held with both hands.
#Target# is being being grounded in the timeline!
Dragon blood runs through your veins. You can breathe fire (or have it improved if you already could).
entries.target: 你流淌着龙的血液。你可以喷吐火焰（如果你原本就会喷火，则吐息会得到强化）。

entries.source: Your Block talent now lasts for 2 game turns and you can apply Counterstrike to any number of enemies.
entries.target: 你的格挡技能持续时间 2 游戏回合，并且你可以使任意数量的敌人进入可以反击的状态。

entries.source: Most certainly, so what are your plans now?
entries.target: 那是自然。那么你现在有什么打算？

entries.source: The target's mind has been shattered. Its body remains as a thrall to %s.
entries.target: 目标的心智已被摧毁，身体仍受 %s 奴役。

entries.source: Before you looms a pair of eyes... a glint of steel... death.
entries.target: 你面前浮现出一双眼睛……一道金属寒光……死亡。

entries.source:
Lay a magical trap that summons a trio of shadowy rogues to attack the target.
The rogues receive your damage bonuses and are permanently stealthed.
They disappear after %d turns or when their work is done.
entries.target:
放置一个魔法陷阱，召唤三名阴影盗贼攻击目标。
这些盗贼继承你的伤害加成，并永久处于潜行状态。
它们会在 %d 回合后，或完成任务时消失。
